sources.title: GitHub - Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge ...
sources.snippet: LIBERO is designed for studying knowledge transfer in multitask and lifelong robot learning problems. Successfully resolving these problems require both declarative knowledge about objects/spatial relationships and procedural knowledge about motion/behaviors.

sources.title: LIBERO Datasets - LIBERO
sources.snippet: LIBERO-Goal: 10 tasks from LIBERO-Goal suite. LIBERO-100: 100 tasks from LIBERO-100 suite. Note that the datasets are split under the folder names of LIBERO-90 and LIBERO-10. We also have a script for programmatic downloading the datasets. Download Checkpoints LIBERO-Spatial Best Model Checkpoints LIBERO-Object Best Model Checkpoints

sources.title: GitHub - ZTX2021/LIBERO_diffusion: fork from LIBERO · GitHub
sources.snippet: In contrast, LIBERO-100 consists of 100 manipulation tasks that require the transfer of entangled knowledge. LIBERO-100 is further splitted into LIBERO-90 for pretraining a policy and LIBERO-10 for testing the agent's downstream lifelong learning performance.
